MORE:
Yug Decor Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 07/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve Pursuant to regulation 29 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, this is to inform that a Meeting of Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled to be held on, Saturday, 07th November, 2026 at 3:00 P.M. at the Registered Office of the Company situated at Ahmedabad inter alia to consider, approve and take on record the following matters:
1) Approval of Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the half year ended on 30th September, 2026.
2) Any other matter which the Board may deem fit and necessary.
